newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - AOL FY 98 eps upped - Lehman.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - AOL FY 98 eps upped - Lehman.

text.p: -- Lehman Brothers analyst Brian Oakes said he raised his fiscal 1998 earnings estimates on America Online to $1.00 a share, from $0.85 previously, due to its better-than-expected third quarter earnings.
-- Oakes also reiterated a buy rating on the stock, with a price target of $80 a share, over the next 12 months.

-- Oakes also said the valuation of AOL's network is not reflected in AOL's current stock price, based on the $616 million merger announced earlier today with GTE Corp buying BBN Corp. BBN provides about one third of AOL's network, AOLnet, Oakes said.
